blocks.text: SYDNEY — A magnitude 6.3 earthquake struck off the coast of South Pacific nation Vanuatu on Tuesday, the US Geological Survey said. The tremor’s epicenter was about 200 kilometers (120 miles) northwest of the village of Port Olry. There was “no tsunami threat“, according to the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center.
